import axios from'axios';const API_URL='http://localhost:8080/api/restaurants';// Function to get all restaurants
export const getAllRestaurants=()=>{return axios.get(API_URL);};// Function to get a single restaurant by its ID
export const getRestaurantById=id=>{return axios.get("".concat(API_URL,"/").concat(id));};// Function to search restaurants by cuisine
export const searchByCuisine=cuisine=>{return axios.get("".concat(API_URL,"/cuisine/").concat(cuisine));};// Function to create a new restaurant
export const createRestaurant=restaurantData=>{return axios.post(API_URL,restaurantData);};// Function to update an existing restaurant
export const updateRestaurant=(id,restaurantData)=>{return axios.put("".concat(API_URL,"/").concat(id),restaurantData);};// Function to delete a restaurant
export const deleteRestaurant=id=>{return axios.delete("".concat(API_URL,"/").concat(id));};
